0022600143.text: The Lakers (3-0, on a three-game winning streak, 1st in the Pacific and 3rd in the West) visit the LA Clippers (1-2, 3rd in the Pacific and 2 games back, 9th in the West) in the Lakers' fifth game of the season. Lakers players Adou Thiero (knee, inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique, strain) are out, while the Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee, inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), Max Strus (foot, plantar fasciitis), Rui Hachimura (quadriceps, soreness) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery). The Lakers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 125-117 win in Los Angeles on October 23, and the teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2.
